title: Black Benny and what Morton said of other musicians
summary: Discussion of Black Benny, Morton not bragging with Carew, and his praise of Simeon, Keppard and Perez.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: I never remember seeing anything or hearing anything of Black Benny at that time. He was supposed to be a fairly well-known character.

I heard his name, but I think it was according to Saints. I don't remember. But there were players playing places that I would stand on the sidewalk and listen to me and never had an idea who was playing inside. Oh, boy. Jolly, Jolly was not like a lot of people imagine. As far as I was concerned, he didn't do much bragging with me. He would state what he thought, you know. Yeah, well, that's, I remember, as the not bragging. But he depended, I think, in my case, I think he depended on the fact that he knew I lived in New Orleans, and I knew a lot of that stuff myself, you know.

Well, I used to talk to him, and then, because I asked him about a lot of other musicians and all that, you know. He never talked much about himself, but he had plenty to say about Umber Simeon, for example, and Freddie Kepler and Perez. Yeah, that's right. He liked them.
